desc.home: Thirteen bungalows on the Arapiuns River, 90 minutes by boat from Alter do Chão. Stay for days with full board, or come on a package with the boat and itinerary already arranged.
desc.lodge: The 13 bungalows of Villa Arapiuns: two-storey Tapajônica architecture, mahogany, marquetry and handwoven cloth.
desc.dining: The table at Villa Arapiuns: river fish, cassava flour from the community, coffee brewed to order — and the Piracaia at the water's edge.
desc.experiences: Trails, canoe, beach and workshops with the riverside communities of the Arapiuns.
desc.packages: Packages departing from Alter do Chão with boat, itinerary and half board: one night with seven experiences, or two nights with ten.
desc.privateVilla: The whole of Villa Arapiuns for one group: retreats, company teams, birdwatching and night dive-fishing with the families who live on the river. Exclusive use from 15 people.
desc.gettingHere: How to reach Villa Arapiuns: fly to Santarém, transfer to Alter do Chão and 90 minutes by boat upriver.
desc.gallery: Photographs of Villa Arapiuns: the bungalows, the river, the forest and the Arapiuns communities.
desc.reviews: What guests say after staying at Villa Arapiuns.
desc.book: Book your stay at Villa Arapiuns on WhatsApp and talk straight to the house.
desc.bookSent: Your message arrived. We reply within 24 hours.

home.hookA: A freshwater Caribbean, warm all year, inside the forest.
home.hookB: And you sleep there. It's unforgettable.
home.intro: The beach is fresh water, clear to the bottom, and there are hardly any mosquitoes. That is the Arapiuns. The bungalows are timber, Tapajônica architecture, feet in the sand. Come for a few days — or come and live here. Why not?
home.travessiaI: Getting here is part of it. Three stages, and the last one is ours.
home.etapa1D: Santarém airport, in Pará. This is where the journey starts to be worth it.
home.etapa2D: Overland transfer to the village. We agree the time with you.
home.etapa3T: Alter do Chão to the Villa
home.etapa3D: The house boat, upriver. Included in the packages; arranged separately on lodge stays.
home.vistaLegenda: The Villa from above · the roofs inside closed forest
home.vistaDesc: Aerial video, filmed straight down: the thatched roofs and the solar panels of the Villa surrounded by unbroken forest.
home.casaP1: The doors are mahogany, inlaid: wedges of opposing grain radiating from an octagonal centre, cut and fitted by hand. The same octagon returns as a medallion on the interior doors.
home.casaP2: The blankets are woven on a loom, checked in chocolate and oat. The veranda lamp is woven fibre. The bungalows are two-storey Tapajônica architecture. None of it came out of a catalogue — and that is why the Villa looks like no other lodge on the river.
home.diaI: From coffee on the veranda to the fire on the beach. Each moment tells you whether it is included or paid directly to the community.
home.precoD: The nightly rate comes down as the group grows and the stay lengthens. Tell us how many people and how many nights, and we come back with a firm price on WhatsApp — no forms.
home.fechaQ: You arrive, drop your bags and head straight out. You come back tired in the best possible way — from the forest, the sun, the stories. You eat well and you sleep deeply.
home.fechaD: The person who answers is the person who welcomes you. Tell us how many people and what dates you have in mind.

pousada.intro: Tapajônica architecture on stilts, between the trees and the freshwater beach. Up to 26 guests in the whole Villa — and never more than that.
pousada.matP1: The doors are mahogany, inlaid: wedges of opposing grain radiating from an octagonal centre, cut and fitted by hand. The same octagon returns as a medallion on the interior doors.
pousada.matP2: The blankets are woven on a loom, checked in chocolate and oat. The veranda lamp is woven fibre, and so is the floor mat. Nothing came out of a catalogue.
pousada.tipo1D: Bungalow on stilts, with its own veranda facing the forest.
pousada.tipo2D: Two-storey unit with an internal staircase.
pousada.tipo3D: Two suites in the same duplex unit — for a family or a group that wants to stay together.
pousada.tiposNota: Which type you get depends on how full the date is. Tell us the size of your group and we will fit you in.
pousada.c1D: Hammocks in the shade, with birdsong. The gap between one adventure and the next.
pousada.c2D: Thatched roof, long timber table, open to the forest.
pousada.c3D: Feet in the sand, clear water. It is the front of the lodge.
pousada.c4D: A covered space for practice, or for doing nothing at all.
pousada.viverT: What it is like to live here
pousada.viverI: Three things nobody asks about before arriving, and everybody mentions afterwards.
pousada.mosquitoD: The clear water and sand beaches of the Arapiuns have far fewer mosquitoes than the floodplain Amazon. Dinner on the sand without repellent is the surprise that comes up most often from people who arrive expecting the opposite.
pousada.aguaT: The shower doesn't need a heater
pousada.aguaD: There's no water heater at the Villa, because the climate doesn't call for one. Your shower is the natural water from our own well, at whatever temperature it arrives — and that changes with the season — it's the part that brings guests closest to the place. For drinking, there's a filter: safe water at all times.
pousada.telaD: There is Starlink internet, for keeping in touch. Television, no. At night what there is is conversation, the sound of the river and the urge to sleep early.

exp.h1: What there is to do here
exp.intro: Trails, canoe, beach and meeting the river communities. On lodge stays, excursions are arranged separately; in the packages, they come with the itinerary.
exp.nota: Some excursions are paid directly to the families who host the group. Each item says which applies.
exp.estacoesI: There is no bad time to come — there are two different landscapes, and they change what you can do. The water is warm and clear in both.
exp.cheiaD: The river rises and moves into the forest. The igapós appear — flooded woodland — and the canoe goes right through them, between the treetops, where the rest of the year you would be walking.
exp.secaD: The water draws back and the beaches appear: banks of white sand that did not exist six months earlier, and that will vanish again when the river rises.
exp.estacoesNota: The Arapiuns is warm all year round. What changes between the seasons is the landscape, not the climate.

chegar.intro: Three stages, and the last one is ours. The journey is part of it — and that is why the Villa is never crowded.
chegar.q1: What if my flight is delayed?
chegar.a1: Let us know on WhatsApp as soon as you do. The boat leaves when the group arrives; we rearrange the time with you.
chegar.q2: Do I need to book the boat separately?
chegar.a2: In the packages the boat is already included. On lodge stays the transfer is arranged separately — ask for it along with the rate.
chegar.q3: How long does it take from Santarém to the Villa?
chegar.a3: The Alter do Chão–Villa leg is 90 minutes by boat. The time from Santarém to Alter do Chão depends on the transfer, and we arrange that with you.
chegar.a4: The signal comes and goes. Settle whatever needs settling beforehand, and tell anyone who is expecting to hear from you.
chegar.a5: You can. Tell us their ages when you get in touch, so we can think about the accommodation and the pace of the day together with you.
chegar.figFimEtapa3: The end of stage 03 · landing on the Villa’s sand
chegar.duvFinal: If a question is still unanswered here, just ask — it's faster than searching.

privativa.h1: The whole Villa, for your group alone
privativa.intro: From 15 people the Villa runs on exclusive use: the thirteen bungalows, the pavilion, the hammock grove and the beach, with nobody from outside. Retreats come here, and so do company teams, birdwatchers, and people who want to learn dive-fishing from the families who live on the river.
privativa.b2D: Above that number, nobody else comes in on your date.
privativa.b3D: Wedding, retreat, training, birthday — the day is organised around your group.
privativa.nota: Groups of more than 26 guests: please ask about availability.
privativa.figGrupoAgua: A group in the water · the whole Villa reserved
privativa.espacosI: Four shared spaces, and with exclusive use they belong only to your group: no one from outside comes in on your dates.
privativa.espacoShala: The shala · the whole group under thatch
privativa.espacoShalaAlt: Long thatched pavilion with solar panels on the roof, fifteen people standing on the wooden deck in late afternoon light
privativa.espacoRefeitorioAlt: Long dining hall tables set with woven straw placemats and dark mugs
privativa.espacoRodaFogoAlt: Solid tree-trunk benches in a circle on the sand of the clearing, surrounded by forest
privativa.espacoRedario: The hammock shelter · hammocks in the shade, facing the river
privativa.espacoRedarioAlt: Two striped hammocks slung under a thatched roof set on the sand, with the forest and the river behind
privativa.b4D: It comes down with the number of people and the number of nights, and booking the whole Villa has a rate of its own. Bring us your dates and we'll settle the figure.
privativa.publicosI: Four ways of using the same house. What changes is the shape of the day — the structure is always this one.
privativa.retiroD: The thatched pavilion holds the whole group seated in a circle, and practice starts before breakfast. After the day there are the hammocks among the trees, the beach and the river, and nobody else's schedule to work around. Yoga, meditation and teacher-training retreats have already been held here with the house closed.
privativa.figRetiro: The circle in the pavilion · the house closed for one group
privativa.figRetiroAlt: A circle of about twenty people sitting on mats on the wooden floor of the thatched pavilion, facing a facilitator who is standing, with the forest visible through the open bays
privativa.corpD: Covered space for the team together, a long table to work at, and a whole day of activity outside it: trail, canoe, cassava-flour making with the communities. The team arrives together and shares the house with no one else.
privativa.corpConexao: About signal, let's be straight. There is Starlink on site for what cannot wait, and it will not carry the whole team through an online meeting at once. What this trip delivers is not an office with a view: it is the team in one place with no screen in between — which is usually the reason for bringing people out here at all.
privativa.figCorp: The thatched pavilion · where the group sits all together
privativa.figCorpAlt: Open pavilion with a thatched roof over a wooden floor, with a lounger, surrounded by forest
privativa.avesD: The good outing is the first one: before the sun, by canoe through the flooded forest and on foot through the woods, with the guide from the lodge and with the residents of Atodi, who have always walked there. There is no tower and no hide — there is the right hour, the silence, and people who know where to look.
privativa.figAves: Canoe in the flooded forest · the morning outing
privativa.figAvesAlt: Four people inside a wooden canoe in the flooded forest, among submerged trunks and vines, on dark still water
privativa.pescaD: It goes out after dinner, in the residents' canoe. The technique is theirs: a lamp in the water, a free dive, a hand spear. The people teaching it are the people who fish there every day, and whatever the river gives that night goes to the table.
privativa.pescaNota: Paid directly to the community and led by people who hold the right to fish inside the Tapajós-Arapiuns Extractive Reserve. This is not sport fishing.
privativa.figPesca: The night table · fish grilled by candlelight
privativa.figPescaAlt: Large fish split and grilled over coals on banana leaves, with lime wedges, laid on a mat on the sand by candlelight
privativa.respI: It is what a group needs to be able to say afterwards, and here it does not rest on goodwill: there are five verifiable facts.

respLista.titulo: The money goes into the community
respLista.detalhe: Cassava-flour making, weaving, massage and the community visits are paid directly to the families who host the group. They do not pass through the lodge.

respLista.titulo: The guide and the crew are from there
respLista.detalhe: The kitchen, the boat and the route are in the hands of people who live on the river. It is local work, not an itinerary brought in from outside.
The Arapiuns runs inside the Tapajós-Arapiuns Extractive Reserve, and what is fished there follows the reserve's fishing agreement.
The panels sit on the pavilion roof, in plain sight of anyone walking past, and they are where the house gets its power.

respLista.titulo: The group is the size of the house
respLista.detalhe: Thirteen bungalows, twenty-six guests at most. The limit is not a marketing position: it is what the Villa has.

aval.intro: We have not published reviews on this page yet.
aval.corpo: We would rather not show a score or a testimonial without being able to show the source. When this page exists, it will carry verifiable reviews, with origin and date. Until then, the most direct route is to talk to the people who welcome you: ask on WhatsApp and we will tell you how it works, with no sales script.

reservar.intro: No booking engine, no cart. You write — on WhatsApp or through this form — and the person who answers is the person who receives you.
